name: Town of Mamaroneck (unincorporated)
gaps: § 240-59.1 chart: column 4 totals for rows 6 (330.000), 26, 27, 43, 46 and 47 do not equal lot x FAR as printed; bands use lot x FAR from columns 2-3
Maximum size can be exceeded up to the neighborhood average of comparison parcels (§ 240-59.1C), which the bands cannot capture
No separate building-footprint limit in one-family/R-2F districts; the 35% lot coverage includes drives and paved areas, so it is recorded as max_impervious_coverage
R-GA, R-A and R-TA set no minimum lot width; R-TA side/rear yards are height-based formulas (left null)
No accessory dwelling unit provision found; § 240-58B bars residence use of accessory buildings except for domestic employees
No standalone steep slope law; Ch. 95 only defines steep slopes (1 ft rise per 4 ft = 25%) for erosion-control plans
Accessory side/rear of 5 ft applies only to one-story/15 ft detached buildings in the rear third of the lot

wetlands.summary: Ch. 114: 100 ft wetland/watercourse buffer; structures, fill, grading, utilities and vegetation removal in a wetland, watercourse or buffer need a wetland/watercourse permit.

steep_slopes.summary: No separate steep slope law; Ch. 95 defines steep slopes as 1 ft vertical per 4 ft horizontal (25%) and addresses them in surface water and erosion control plans.

trees.summary: Ch. 207: permit to remove any regulated tree (6 in.+ DBH, dead or hazardous trees, or any replacement tree); clearing = more than 7 regulated trees in 12 months.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 95: surface water and erosion control permit for minor land development (over 100 sf of disturbance or new impervious cover, under 1 acre); SWPPP permit for 1 acre or more.

adu.summary: No accessory apartment provision found in Ch. 240; accessory buildings may not be used as residences except for domestic employees (§ 240-58B); up to two roomers/boarders allowed without separate kitchens (§ 240-21C(2)).

general.accessory_structures: Detached accessory buildings up to one story / 15 ft in the rear third of the lot may be 5 ft from property lines (not nearer the street than the front setback on corner lots); terraces/decks <= 18 in. high are excluded from coverage and must stay 5 ft from side/rear lines (§ 240-50); tennis courts in the rear third, 15 ft from lines.
general.pools: Ch. 192: pool coping/deck at least 15 ft from side lot lines and the house, 20 ft from the rear line, not in required front or side yards, 5 ft from accessory structures, 25 ft from septic.
general.notes: Height measured to the mean of eaves and ridge for pitched roofs; half story = sloping roof no more than 2 ft above the floor on two opposite sides. Minimum first-floor areas apply by district.

R-50.name: One-Family Residence R-50

max_impervious_coverage.note: Lot coverage: buildings, accessory structures, pools, courts, drives and paved areas (terraces/decks <= 18 in. above grade excluded, § 240-50)

max_floor_area.note: § 240-59.1 chart: lot x FAR at each 1,000 sf row, plus 10 sf per 100 sf (or part) above the row; over 50,000 sf: 9,712.50 + 10 sf/100 sf, never above 15,000 sf. All buildings on the lot count; basements and low-headroom attic space excluded. The owner may instead build up to the average total square footage of comparison parcels within 300 ft. Applies to one- and two-family lots.

accessory.notes: Detached accessory building of one story / 15 ft or less in the rear third of the lot may sit 5 ft from the property line; on a corner lot not nearer the street than the front setback. Otherwise principal setbacks apply.

R-50.notes: Corner lots need a front yard on each street; owner picks the rear yard (§ 240-54).
